method: Full-field editorial translation with era-specific historical research; not an independent scholarly certification.

sourceExceptions.reason: Original refers to recent defeat of the Pacific Railroad Funding Bill during a 1896 campaign; the identified H.R. 8189 vote occurred January 11, 1897. Preserve source and disclose likely chronology issue without claiming no other bill existed.
Tin is rendered as tin-plate in the immediate question context, not as mining raw tin.
Tin industry is rendered as tin-plate industry in the immediate question context; original literal remains unchanged.

revisions.source: If they can get a Bryan-Watson ticket on the ballot, good for them. We will sort this issue out after we win the election in November.
revisions.zh: 如果他们能让布赖恩—沃森组合出现在选票上，那就随他们去吧。等我们十一月赢下大选，再解决这个问题。

revisions.source: It's a shame that this policy wasn't implemented decades ago. For too long, rural Americans have been forced to travel up to thirty miles to retrieve the mail they are entitled to.
revisions.zh: 这项政策几十年前就该实行，却一直没有，实在遗憾。长期以来，农村居民为了领取本应属于自己的邮件，被迫走上最多三十英里的路。

revisions.source: We should monitor this program very carefully to determine if it can be done in a cost-effective manner.
revisions.zh: 我们应当仔细监督这项计划，看看能否以合理的成本实施。

revisions.source: This policy will hurt the small storeowner and serves as yet another example of wasteful government spending. We should be looking to reduce the deficit -- not to add new programs.
revisions.zh: 这项政策会损害小店主，又是政府浪费开支的一个例子。我们应该减少赤字，而不是增设计划。

revisions.source: The current system for selecting Senators is unimaginably corrupt. State legislatures have every incentive to select the most corrupt, retrograde candidate for the job.
revisions.zh: 现行联邦参议员选任制度，腐败得难以想象。州议会有各种动机，把最腐败、最顽固守旧的人选送进参议院。

revisions.source: I neither support, nor do I oppose this idea for an Amendment. My job as President will be to enforce the law as it stands.
revisions.zh: 对于这项宪法修正案提议，我既不支持，也不反对。我当上总统后的职责，是执行现行法律。

revisions.source: The purpose of the Senate is to act as an objective legislative body. It is dangerous to tamper with the Constitutional provisions established by our founding fathers.
revisions.zh: 参议院的作用，是成为一个客观的立法机构。随意改动建国先贤确立的宪法规定，是危险的。

revisions.source: At the very least, a federal law prohibiting the sale of alcohol of Sunday seems appropriate.
revisions.zh: 至少，制定一项禁止星期日售酒的联邦法律，似乎是恰当的。

revisions.source: This debate has no place in our system of federalism. The individual states have every right to decide how they wish to handle the issue of commerce and drinking on Sunday.
revisions.zh: 在我们的联邦制下，这不应成为联邦层面的争论。各州完全有权自行决定，如何处理星期日的商业活动与饮酒问题。

revisions.source: I don't support the mandated closing of shops on Sunday.
revisions.zh: 我不支持强制商店在星期日停业。

revisions.source: I envision an American canal, built by American workers, property of the American government, supporting the actions of a robust American Navy. I fully support these plans.
revisions.zh: 我设想的是一条美国的运河：由美国工人建造，属于美国政府，支持强大的美国海军行动。我完全赞成这些计划。

revisions.source: This could be a fantastic method of creating work for our idle workers. What better way is there to implement a massive public works project?
revisions.zh: 这也许是给失业工人创造工作的绝佳办法。还有什么比这更适合实施大规模公共工程？

revisions.source: Am I understand that we will be sending thousands of men to dig through the hills of Nicaragua on this pipe dream of a project? Allow me to predict that there will never be a canal in that country.
revisions.zh: 你的意思是，我们要派成千上万人，到尼加拉瓜的丘陵里挖掘，去实现这么一个白日梦？容我预言，那个国家永远不会有运河。

revisions.source: Senators should be selected by state legislatures. Why on earth would you want to debase the dignity of that body?
revisions.zh: 联邦参议员应当由州议会选出。为什么非要贬损参议院的尊严？

revisions.source: Boies is a controversial figure to be sure, but he more or less falls into line with your traditional views. Of course, there are a lot of states besides Iowa you need to visit if you're to have a chance...
revisions.zh: 博伊斯的确颇有争议，但大体符合你一贯的观点。当然，你要想有机会，除了艾奥瓦，还得访问许多别的州……

revisions.source: It's a bit much to say that Boies's day is over, although he is a bit past his political prime.
revisions.zh: 说博伊斯的时代结束了，未免过头；不过，他确实已稍稍过了政治生涯的巅峰。

revisions.source: Iowa is a key state and this should help you there.
revisions.zh: 艾奥瓦是关键州，这应该有助于你在那里争取支持。

revisions.source: You can't even get your answer right on the mail issue? Farmers want free mail and they're tired of being ripped off by local storeowners.
revisions.zh: 邮政问题，你竟然也答不对？农民希望免费收到邮件，早就受够了当地店主的盘剥。

revisions.source: Do you approve of Grover Cleveland's handing of the federal budget over the previous four years?
revisions.zh: 你赞同格罗弗·克利夫兰过去四年处理联邦预算的方式吗？

revisions.source: What do you say to the notion that high tariffs hurt farmers?
revisions.zh: 对于“高关税损害农民”这一说法，你如何回应？

revisions.source: What are your thoughts on the Women's Christian Temperance Union? Is this group a positive force in American life?
revisions.zh: 你如何看待妇女基督教禁酒联合会？这个团体对美国社会具有积极作用吗？

revisions.source: Does the success of the tin-plate industry within the U.S. prove that protectionism stimulates industry?
revisions.zh: 美国镀锡板产业的成功，是否证明贸易保护能促进工业？

revisions.source: Are you pleased with the recent defeat in Congress of the Pacific Railroad Funding Bill, which would have provided federal support to the Southern and Central Pacific railroads.
revisions.zh: 《太平洋铁路融资法案》最近在国会遭到否决。它本会向南太平洋和中央太平洋铁路提供联邦支持。你对此满意吗？

revisions.source: This is the type of cronyism that occurs when government selects certain industries for protection under a tariff act. I support low tariffs across the board.
revisions.zh: 政府通过关税法，挑选某些产业加以保护，就会发生这种裙带勾结。我支持全面降低关税。

revisions.source: I'm glad for the men who produce tin for a living, but we need to consider the overall effect of this policy. I don't have a glib answer for you at this point.
revisions.zh: 我为靠生产镀锡板谋生的人感到高兴，但我们需要考虑这项政策的整体影响。眼下，我不能随口给你一个轻巧的答案。

revisions.source: There is nothing I'm more proud of from my time in Congress than creating the conditions that allowed for a booming tin industry to flourish within our borders.
revisions.zh: 我在国会任职期间，最引以为豪的，就是创造了条件，让本国的镀锡板产业蓬勃发展。

revisions.source: The answer here is obvious. High tariffs force farmers to purchase overpriced equipment and do nothing to increase crop prices.
revisions.zh: 答案显而易见。高关税迫使农民购买价格过高的设备，却丝毫不能提高农产品价格。

revisions.source: Perhaps. It depends on if these tariffs cause other countries to retaliate against our agricultural goods. This is always a risk when tariffs are increased in haphazard fashion.
revisions.zh: 也许吧。这取决于，这些关税是否会使其他国家报复我国农产品。随意提高关税，总会有这种风险。

revisions.source: High tariffs protect American industry and increase the purchasing power of the consumer. Free silver would throw this system into chaos and even hurt the farmer in the long-term.
revisions.zh: 高关税保护美国工业，增强消费者的购买力。自由铸银会使这套制度陷入混乱，长期来看，甚至会损害农民。

revisions.source: The WCTU is one of the most spiritually uplifting, morally righteous groups in our society. I pray that the Lord will see fit to guide them to success in their mission.
revisions.zh: 妇女基督教禁酒联合会，是我们社会中最能振奋精神、最具道德正义感的团体之一。我祈祷，上帝能引导她们完成使命。

revisions.source: This is a well-meaning group of honest Christian women. I am neither especially opposed to nor especially supportive of their goals.
revisions.zh: 这是由善意、诚实的基督教妇女组成的团体。对于她们的目标，我既不特别反对，也不特别支持。

revisions.source: This group is Exhibit A in the dangers of allowing women to become politically active. They are engaged in a naive quest to purify American life from an imagined evil.
revisions.zh: 这个团体正是允许妇女参与政治会带来危险的最好例证。她们天真地追求，把一种想象中的罪恶从美国生活中清除出去。

revisions.source: Grover Cleveland has vetoed more pieces of legislation than any President in our history, increased our deficit, and still found a way to provide J.P. Morgan with a financial windfall from the public purse.
revisions.zh: 格罗弗·克利夫兰否决的法案，比美国历史上任何总统都多。他增加了赤字，却仍然想办法，让J. P. 摩根从公共财政中大发横财。

revisions.source: Is there anyone left in the United States who approves of Grover Cleveland? We need to move on from his failed Administration.
revisions.zh: 美国还有谁赞同格罗弗·克利夫兰吗？我们需要告别他那失败的政府。

revisions.source: Grover Cleveland is a citizen of integrity who has done his best under trying circumstances. He was simply found to be not up to the job.
revisions.zh: 格罗弗·克利夫兰是一位正直的公民，在艰难环境中尽了最大努力。只是事实证明，他不胜任这项工作。

revisions.source: I will stand up for Grover Cleveland for the rest of my life. I believe that he is a great man whom our history will greatly vindicate.
revisions.zh: 我会终生支持格罗弗·克利夫兰。我相信，他是一个伟大的人，历史将充分证明他的价值。

revisions.source: It is my firm position that we need to nationalize the railroads of this country. Their power has stood beyond reproach for too long.
revisions.zh: 我的立场很坚定：我们需要把本国铁路收归国有。它们的权势不受质疑，已经太久了。

revisions.source: For all of their talk about small government, the Republicans are quite adept at funneling public money to the railroads. I only support that practice when there is a clear rationale, and in this case the rationale was corruption.
revisions.zh: 共和党嘴上大谈小政府，却很擅长把公款输送给铁路公司。我只在理由充分时才支持这种做法，而这一次，理由就是腐败。

revisions.source: Without federal support including loans and land grants, there are certain railroads which would simply be too large to construct with private capital. I was disappointed by the defeat of this bill.
revisions.zh: 没有包括贷款和赠地在内的联邦支持，某些铁路规模太大，单靠私人资本根本建不成。这项法案遭到否决，让我失望。

revisions.source: I was opposed to this bill. We might have provided land grants and funding for railroads in the past, but that practice will end under my Administration.
revisions.zh: 我反对这项法案。过去，我们或许提供过铁路赠地和资金，但在我的政府任内，这种做法将结束。

revisions.source: Don't undermine your own position on the tariff issue. It does no good for anyone.
revisions.zh: 别削弱自己在关税问题上的立场。这对谁都没有好处。

revisions.source: The WCTU is popular in some rural areas, but not in the northern cities that you need to win this fall.
revisions.zh: 妇女基督教禁酒联合会在一些农村地区很受欢迎，但在你今年秋天需要赢下的北方城市，并非如此。

revisions.source: Nationalize the railroads? What has gotten into you? You might as well quit now, you'll never win in November.
revisions.zh: 铁路国有化？你这是怎么了？不如现在就退出吧，你十一月绝不可能赢。

revisions.source: The voters are confused because you used your time in Congress to fight against tariffs.
revisions.zh: 选民感到困惑，因为你在国会任职时，一直努力反对关税。

revisions.source: What are your views on the Darwinian theory of Evolution?
revisions.zh: 你如何看待达尔文的进化论？

revisions.source:
The respectable city newspapers are unanimously pro-McKinley. As such, William Randolph Hearst senses that supporting you would be a terrific business opportunity.
Can you reassure him that there are limits to your pacifist ideals, particularly in regards to Cuba?
revisions.zh:
有声望的城市报纸一致支持麦金莱。因此，威廉·伦道夫·赫斯特觉得，支持你会是个绝佳的商业机会。
你能否向他保证，你的和平主义理想也有界限，尤其是在古巴问题上？

revisions.source: Governor Altgeld of Illinois has proposed that you appear with him in Chicago for a couple of big speeches. Later on he would appear with you in southern Illinois to solidify his support with rural voters. What do you think of this idea?
revisions.zh: 伊利诺伊州长奥尔特格尔德提议，你与他一起在芝加哥发表几场重要演说。之后，他还会与你一起到伊利诺伊南部，巩固他在农村选民中的支持。你怎么看？

revisions.source: Without compromising on the silver issue, what can you say about McKinley to Bourbon Democrats to try and bring them back into the fold?
revisions.zh: 在不就白银问题妥协的前提下，你能向波旁民主党人怎样评价麦金莱，争取让他们回归本党阵营？

revisions.source: Altgeld is free to appear with me at any event, but I will not rearrange my entire schedule to suit his needs.
revisions.zh: 奥尔特格尔德可以与我一起出席任何活动，但我不会为迁就他的需要，重排整套行程。

revisions.source: On many industrial issues, such as the Pullman Strike and his pardon of the Haymarket anarchists, Altgeld is too radical. I would prefer not to appear with him.
revisions.zh: 在普尔曼大罢工、赦免干草市场案无政府主义者等许多与劳资有关的问题上，奥尔特格尔德过于激进。我宁愿不与他同台。

revisions.source: This sounds like a good idea. Farmers and other laborers need to be unified this fall if we're to have a chance of beating McKinley.
revisions.zh: 这个主意不错。今年秋天，我们要想击败麦金莱，就必须把农民和其他劳动者团结起来。

revisions.source: I cannot support the exploitation of foreign peoples in good conscience. The Bible states that thou shalt not kill, and that is my position as well.
revisions.zh: 凭良心说，我不能支持剥削外国人民。《圣经》说，不可杀人；这也正是我的立场。

revisions.source: William Randolph Hearst knows my opinions and he is free to endorse me or not endorse me. I will not cater to his whims.
revisions.zh: 威廉·伦道夫·赫斯特知道我的看法，愿意支持我或不支持，都是他的自由。我不会迎合他的奇想。

revisions.source: New York and California are important states, and of course I support the uplift of primitive peoples with American influence. What's not to like in this arrangement?
revisions.zh: 纽约和加利福尼亚很重要。当然，我也支持通过美国的影响，提升原始民族的文明水平。这种安排有什么不好？

revisions.source: McKinley has proposed some of the most dastardly tariffs to ever see the light of day in this country.
revisions.zh: 麦金莱提出的关税，简直是这个国家所见过最卑劣的一批。

revisions.source: McKinley will run a radical pro-monopolist Administration that should frighten any ordinary American.
revisions.zh: 麦金莱将组成一个激进地支持垄断者的政府，任何普通美国人都该感到害怕。

revisions.source: We can all agree that the growth in the deficit is concerning. I will fight for an income tax Amendment that will allow us to close this gap without increasing tariffs.
revisions.zh: 我们都能同意，赤字增长令人担忧。我会争取通过一项所得税宪法修正案，让我们不用提高关税，就能弥补缺口。

revisions.source: With the new perspectives I bring, I will be in a unique position to ensure clean, honest government at the federal level. McKinley, on the other hand, is a Republican hack who will continue the status quo.
revisions.zh: 我带来的新视角，使我有独特的条件，确保联邦政府廉洁、诚实。而麦金莱不过是个共和党政客，会继续维持现状。

revisions.source: I agree with the concept of 'survival of the fittest'. It is the destiny of the strong to expand at the expense of the weak.
revisions.zh: 我赞同“适者生存”的观念。强者以牺牲弱者为代价扩张，这是命运使然。

revisions.source: I have no comment to make on Darwinism. This is completely irrelevant to my expected duties as President of the United States.
revisions.zh: 我对达尔文主义没有评论。这与我预期承担的美国总统职责，毫不相干。

revisions.source: I'm not convinced of the veracity of this theory. It contravenes accepted Christian teaching in a large number of ways.
revisions.zh: 我不确信，这个理论是真的。它在许多方面，违背了公认的基督教教义。

revisions.source: Evolution teaches disregard for the security and dignity of our fellow man. Left unchecked this 'survival of the fittest' mentality will eventually cause indifference to life itself, from which only calamity can ensue.
revisions.zh: 进化论教人漠视同胞的安全和尊严。如果不加约束，这种“适者生存”的心态，最终会使人连生命本身也不在乎，继而只能酿成灾难。

revisions.source: This is a bad response politically. Social Darwinism is still a minority view, held mainly among the Ivy League upper-crust. You shouldn't imply that you agree with such views.
revisions.zh: 从政治上说，这个回答很糟糕。社会达尔文主义仍是少数人的观点，主要流行于常春藤名校的上层精英中。你不应该暗示自己赞同它。

revisions.source: Altgeld is a controversial figure to be sure, but he can greatly help enhance your reputation among urban, immigrant voters.
revisions.zh: 奥尔特格尔德的确颇有争议，但他能极大提升你在城市移民选民中的声望。

revisions.source: It sounds like you are running a sensible, moderate campaign. Will the votes in the center be there for you?
revisions.zh: 听起来，你正在开展一场务实、温和的竞选。中间派的选票，会支持你吗？

revisions.source: This is likely to help you with urban voters, though a few moderates may be turned off by this new allegiance. On the balance, it should be a positive for you.
revisions.zh: 这很可能有助于争取城市选民，不过，一些温和派也许会因这个新盟友而退却。权衡下来，应当还是有利。

revisions.source: You have shown yourself to be a man of integrity, sticking to the Christian views you have always espoused.
revisions.zh: 你坚持了一贯倡导的基督教观点，表明自己是个正直的人。

revisions.source: You have helped yourself in a couple of key states, but at some damage to your pacifist reputation.
revisions.zh: 你在几个关键州得到了帮助，但和平主义者的声誉也受了些损伤。

revisions.source: This is nothing less than a betrayal of your own essence. You are a Creationist and you always will be.
revisions.zh: 这简直是背叛自己的本质。你是创造论者，而且永远都会是。
